shelf.title: The whole shelf
shelf.copy: These are books I read at some point in my life, or at least, books I remembered to add to Goodreads. Many were added from memory, from my teenage years, when the internet wasn't really a thing in my village, let alone Goodreads. I've probably forgotten to add most of them.
